_units: Combined arms A7 (cg_brief queue item 2.5; docs/combined_arms.md 2.10, 2.7.1, 9.3): fire, destruction, smoke dischargers and the vehicles' sounds. Every number is Proposed. Read by VehicleFire (host state), VehicleSmoke (the dischargers) and VehicleFx (every peer's effects); the "models" blocks merge into each model's spec as "fx" (VehicleSpecs). fire: the stages of a fire (2.10.1), seconds; smoke_s the grey smoke before the flames show; the hull burns Vehicle.FIRE_S (lost, then a wreck, as before A7), then burns out for burn_out_s (seeded in the range) and its smoke column stands column_s from the wreck (seeded), then a smoulder for the rest of the deployment. cook_off_s: how long a cook-off pops (seeded); pop_gap_s between pops; pop_kg by rack when the rack names none. detonate_per_s: a cook-off of 120/125 mm rounds (a rack marked big) rolls this each second to go up (2.10.2). fireball: radius r0 + r_per x rounds^(1/3) m, blast min(kg_per x rounds, kg_max) kg TNT on everyone near (2.10.4); toss_rounds: main-gun rounds aboard for the turret to be thrown, else the hull ruptures. toss: m/s up and to the side, spin rad/s. debris: pieces by the seed, asleep after sleep_s, frozen static after freeze_s, at most zone_max live bodies (older ones become plain static meshes, at most static_max kept). vent: the Abrams bustle's column through its blow-out panels, metres and seconds. heat (ThermalView): a burning hull, a burnt-out wreck cooling to ThermalView's cold wreck over cool_s, debris and a thrown turret. budgets (2.10.6, 9.3): full_fires vehicles burning with full effects at once (more show smoke only), particles across the zone (GPU particles), billboard_m past which a column is one billboard, lights at once, fx_ms the CPU a frame the fires and debris may add (6 fires and 64 debris), kill_ms what a catastrophic kill may cost the host in its frame. muzzle: the 120 mm's overpressure: heard as a thump and felt (a shake) within thump_m, ears ringing up to deaf_s for dismounts within harm_m in front of the muzzle (within harm_deg of the bore), the dust kicked up dust_m round it. models: racks (by ammo module id): big (a main-gun round or missile: counts for the fireball and the toss), pop_kg (each cook-off pop's HE); dischargers (2.7.1: the doc's 2 x 6 and 2 x 4): tubes per side's launcher, per_salvo grenades each side throws a salvo, landing range_m out at angles_deg off the turret's line (a screen across the front arc, meeting in front), stowed grenades per side (one full reload), the modules, range_m out, reload_s a salvo; sounds: engine and tracks ids for the interior.
